map.计算表示 N 种状态在给定进制下所需的位数。: Compute the minimum digits needed to represent N states in a chosen radix (e.g. 256 states need 2 hex digits).
map.📖 查看「进制位数计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the Radix Digit Count Guide
map.例如 256 种状态在 16 进制下需 2 位。: For example, 256 states need 2 digits in hexadecimal.
map.状态编码：为有限状态机的状态数选最小进制位数。: State encoding: Pick the fewest radix digits for a finite-state machine's state count.
map.地址/索引规划：N 个单元在 b 进制下所需位数 ⌈log_b(N)⌉。: Address/index planning: Digits needed for N cells in base b is ceil(log_b(N)).
map.表示对比：比较二进制/十六进制表达同一状态空间的紧凑度。: Representation comparison: Compare binary vs hex compactness for the same state space.
map.最少位数 = ⌈log_b(N)⌉，N 为状态总数、b 为进制。: Minimum digits = ceil(log_b(N)), with N the total states and b the radix.
map.前者按\"状态数\"算覆盖所需位数，后者按\"某个具体数值\"算其表示长度。: The former counts digits to cover a number of states; the latter counts the length of a specific value.
map.N≤1 记 1 位（单状态无需区分）。: For N<=1, record 1 digit (a single state needs no distinction).
